howto.what: Claude 会遵循单一职责原则、强制依赖注入、无框架开发、CSS优先交互、严格文件结构等原则来编写或审查Go项目代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求设置Go项目结构、进行代码审查，或询问Go开发最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个Go项目的代码结构是否符合SRP。
say.note: Claude会检查文件职责是否单一。

say.text: 为我的Go应用设计一个依赖注入的main.go。
say.note: Claude会生成符合DI原则的入口文件。

say.text: 这个Go CLI工具如何实现非交互式执行？

howto.what_en: Claude will follow principles like Single Responsibility, mandatory Dependency Injection, framework-less development, CSS-first interactivity, and strict file structure when writing or reviewing Go project code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to set up a Go project structure, perform code review, or inquire about Go development best practices.

say_en.text: Review this Go project's code structure for SRP compliance.
say_en.note: Claude checks if each file has a single purpose.

say_en.text: Design a dependency injection main.go for my Go app.
say_en.note: Claude generates an entry point following DI rules.

say_en.text: How to make this Go CLI tool non-interactive?
say_en.note: Claude explains stdout/stderr separation and exit codes.
